text:
Two tables, before the numbers.

First, what this rests on, in two tables. What the owner weighed and owns: struts of 15 to 22 kilograms, and a 1,500 pound, twelve volt winch. And what a person assumed, each with a reason: where the trees stand, how high the ropes are tied, how far they sag, what rope, wood and cloth will take. 53 figures. Every load in this film uses the heaviest strut. Change any line, and every number after it changes.
